description: A community Christmas gift drive for kids in Caribou County, ID. Add your kids to Santa's list, or sign up to give.

hero.headline: Santa's list is open for every kid in our valley.
hero.lead: Neighbors across Caribou County are teaming up to put something special under every tree this year. Add your kids to Santa's list, add a family you love, or join in as a giver or volunteer.

organization.name: Fool Throttle Foundation
organization.description: Fool Throttle Foundation is the nonprofit organizing this year's toy drive. We coordinate Santa's list, volunteers and donations so every gift goes straight to a kid in our area.
organization.taxNote: Our application for 501(c)(3) status is pending, so we can't provide tax-deduction receipts at this time.

partners.name: Stockman's Bar
partners.description: Stockman's Bar in Soda Springs is proudly partnering with us to collect toys and rally the community. Stop by to drop off a gift and say thanks!

dropOffLocations.name: Stockman's Bar
dropOffLocations.address: 96 S Main Street, Soda Springs, ID 83276
